title: Best Damn App Reviews Scraper input
description: Paste App Store or Google Play links (or bare app ids) and choose how many reviews you want. Every review is one billable result; apps that cannot be found are reported for free.

apps.title: Apps
apps.description: One app per line. Accepts App Store URLs (`https://apps.apple.com/us/app/.../id324684580`), Google Play URLs (`https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.spotify.music`), numeric Apple app ids (`324684580`) and Android package names (`com.spotify.music`). The store is detected automatically and duplicates are removed.

country.title: Country
country.description: Two-letter store country code (`us`, `gb`, `de`, `jp`, ...). Each App Store country has its own reviews, so run once per country for wider coverage. A country inside an App Store URL overrides this value for that app.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language code for Google Play (`en`, `de`, `pt-BR`, ...). The App Store feed does not filter by language and returns whatever language reviewers wrote in.

sort.title: Sort order
sort.description: `newest` returns the most recent reviews first, `helpful` the ones with most helpful votes, `rating` the highest rated first. The App Store feed only supports newest and helpful natively; for `rating` all available Apple reviews are downloaded and sorted.

maxReviewsPerApp.title: Max reviews per app
maxReviewsPerApp.description: Stop after this many reviews for each app. The public App Store feed exposes at most 500 reviews per app and country, so higher values only matter for Google Play.

minRating.title: Minimum rating
minRating.description: Only keep reviews with at least this many stars (1-5).

maxRating.title: Maximum rating
maxRating.description: Only keep reviews with at most this many stars (1-5). Set both limits to 1 to collect complaints only, or 4-5 for praise.

timeoutSecs.title: Request timeout (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: Give up on a single store request after this many seconds.
